results.name: Seed fixture validates and every planned date states where it came from
A planned date cannot be recorded without an explicit basis, and Date needed is a real value
Restricted customer scope applies to permitted records, queries and counts
Owner, source, reason, state and due filters combine without losing source context
Read-only and out-of-capability roles refuse writes atomically
Customer feedback must state whether it is quoted, paraphrased or interpreted
A positive comment does not change any measured or independently sourced outcome
A review cannot be completed while a commitment has no disposition
Completing a review sets only the aftercare outcome and leaves the rest untouched
A completed review retains its open obligations and shows them separately
A completed review is corrected by appending, never by overwriting
An existing case is linked once and similar wording never merges records
A referral requires the duplicate check and every receiving field
Prepared, submitted, returned and accepted stay four separate states
A returned referral is corrected without rewriting the original request
Training material applicability is resolved against the exact model and configuration
Planned, confirmed, attended, delivered and assessed remain five separate states
Document requests are prepared for the document workflow and never duplicated
A commercial discussion carries its source observation and every open issue
MA-05 owns the agreement; CR-05 only links a renewal review
A new CRM handover needs a deliberate review and cannot duplicate a linked opportunity
An unknown receiving outcome blocks a second submission until it is reconciled
A confirmed receiving reference cannot be recorded twice
Stale record and stale session versions refuse and retain the original state
An original operation replays idempotently and a reused identity with different content refuses
A source change retains earlier content and flags the record for reassessment
Closing requires a completed review, dispositioned commitments and reconciled outcomes
Ownership changes are recorded without silently transferring the other owners
Malformed sessions refuse and a valid serialised session round-trips unchanged
